summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Melco Resorts & Entertainment Ltd, a foreign private issuer, furnishing the 2025 annual report of its subsidiary, Melco Resorts Finance Limited. It contains audited financial statements, management's discussion, and descriptions of outstanding senior notes. There is no transaction event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; it is a routine periodic financial report. No deal terms are present.
